# Appendix A: Thalion's source files

Thalion's released source has 40 assembler files; the engine includes all but `FAIRY.S`, which is the fantasy intro. They are not in this repository; the build finds them through `AMBER_URCODE` and assembles them **unchanged**. *Unit* is the translation unit that includes the file (`library` = `engine/engine.s`, `game` = `engine/spiel.s`); *companion* is our file of the same name that supplies what the original took from `AM2_CPU`.

| File | Lines | Unit | Companion | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `ACTIONS.S` | 2363 | game |  | Wrapped in `opt t-`: Thalion's assembler shortened `btst d0,#imm` to a byte, vasm refuses it. The build assembles `spiel.s` a second time without the option and expects exactly this one message (finding 189). |

## Thalion's binaries used by the build

| File | Use | Tool |
|---|---|---|
| `AM2_CPU` | Thalion's unreleased library (Amiga executable). Read only at build time: data and pure memory code (appendix C). Never read at run time. | `tools/am2cpu_auszug.py`, `tools/am2cpu_code.py` |
| `Ambermoon_intro` | The intro without source. Split into hunks at build time and rebound (K1 hardware addresses, K2 blitter) into `INTRO.TOS`; its start menu texts also feed our start menu. | `tools/amiga_programm.py intro`, `tools/intro_auszug.py` |
| `Extro` | The extro without source, imploded. Unpacked, split and rebound like the intro into `EXTRO.TOS`. | `tools/imploder_exe.py`, `tools/amiga_programm.py extro` |
| `Text.amb` | Game data, read at run time (`Lade_texte`); the build only computes where the library texts lie in it. | `tools/textmarken.py` |
